svg.title: Observability · Containers, metrics and data paths by layer
svg.text: Docker Compose · one Prometheus and one Grafana
Observability · Containers, metrics and data paths by layer
Proposal from OBSERVABILITY.md · Traefik per ADR-004 · the database host and P-08 are open
End users reach only the services, through Traefik. DEV reaches Grafana through an SSH tunnel (section 12).
Prometheus scrapes every 30 s: services, RabbitMQ, Traefik, host (proposal), blackbox, and the database exporter over P-08.
Items marked P-08 and the proposals are not in ADR-004.
